result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a CQRS feature (request, handler, optional response)

USAGE:
    shf make:feature <name> [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    shf make:feature Weather/GetForecastsByCity
    shf make:feature Mails/SendMail --command

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Feature path in the form <Domain>/<Operation>, e.g.               
              Weather/GetForecastsByCity                                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help              Prints help information                             
        --command           Force command (no response) shape even if the name  
                            starts with Get/List/Find                           
        --query             Force query (with response) shape regardless of name
        --no-response       Skip generating the Response class (only meaningful 
                            for queries)                                        
        --force             Overwrite existing files                            
        --dry-run           Print what would be written without touching disk   
        --project <PATH>    Path to the Business project. Auto-detected from cwd
                            if omitted

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a minimal API endpoint

USAGE:
    shf make:endpoint <name> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Endpoint identifier in the form <Domain>/<Operation>, e.g.        
              Weather/GetForecastsByCity                                        

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help               Prints help information                            
        --query              Force GET endpoint wired to a Query slice          
                             (Result<Response> envelope)                        
        --command            Force POST endpoint wired to a Command slice       
                             (Result envelope, no response)                     
        --route <PATTERN>    Route override. Defaults to                        
                             api/v1/<Domain>/<Operation>                        
        --summary <TEXT>     OpenAPI summary. Defaults to the operation name    
                             humanized                                          
        --force              Overwrite existing files                           
        --dry-run            Print what would be written without touching disk  
        --project <PATH>     Path to the WebApi project. Auto-detected from cwd 
                             if omitted

DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a Domain entity

USAGE:
    shf make:entity <name> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Entity identifier in the form <Domain>/<Name>, e.g.               
              Weather/Forecast                                                  

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                 Prints help information                          
        --properties <LIST>    Comma-separated Name:Type pairs, e.g.            
                               "Title:string,Quantity:int,Notes:string?"        
        --record               Emit a positional record instead of a class with 
                               set-accessors                                    
        --no-id                Skip the default Id (Guid) property              
        --no-timestamp         Skip the default CreatedAt (DateTimeOffset)      
                               property                                         
        --force                Overwrite existing files                         
        --dry-run              Print what would be written without touching disk
        --project <PATH>       Path to the Domain project. Auto-detected from   
                               cwd if omitted

DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a provider contract + project skeleton

USAGE:
    shf make:provider <name> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Provider name in PascalCase, e.g. Sms, Storage, Payment

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                     Prints help information                      
        --first-driver <DRIVER>    Seed one driver immediately (e.g. Twilio for 
                                   Sms). Adds it to the ProviderType enum and   
                                   the factory switch                           
        --force                    Overwrite existing files                     
        --dry-run                  Print what would be written without touching 
                                   disk                                         
        --project <PATH>           Path to the Business project. Auto-detected  
                                   from cwd if omitted; the other targets derive
                                   from it

DESCRIPTION:
Add a new driver to an existing provider

USAGE:
    shf make:provider-driver <provider> <driver> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <provider>    Existing provider name (e.g. Mail, Sms). Must match a         
                  Providers.<Provider> project                                  
    <driver>      New driver name in PascalCase (e.g. Smtp, Twilio, SendGrid)   

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help              Prints help information                             
        --force             Overwrite the driver file if it already exists      
        --dry-run           Print what would be written without touching disk   
        --project <PATH>    Path to the Business project. Auto-detected from cwd
                            if omitted

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Scaffold a persistence project (PostgreSQL / SQL Server / SQLite)

USAGE:
    shf make:persistence <variant> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <variant>    One of: postgres, sqlserver, sqlite, couchbase

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                        Prints help information                   
        --connection-string <CONN>    Override the default connection string    
                                      written to appsettings.json. If unset, a  
                                      placeholder default is used               
        --localdb                     sqlserver only — use LocalDB as the       
                                      default connection string. Ignored for    
                                      other variants                            
        --force                       Overwrite existing files                  
        --dry-run                     Print what would be written without       
                                      touching disk                             
        --project <PATH>              Path to the Business project.             
                                      Auto-detected from cwd if omitted

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Add a design-time EF Core migration to a persistence project

USAGE:
    shf make:migration <name> [OPTIONS]

ARGUMENTS:
    <name>    Migration name in PascalCase (e.g. AddForecastTable,              
              RenameUserEmail)                                                  

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                     Prints help information                      
        --persistence <PROJECT>    Persistence project name (e.g.               
                                   Persistence.PostgreSql). Auto-detected when  
                                   there is exactly one Persistence.* project   
                                   under src/                                   
        --output-dir <DIR>         Migrations output directory relative to the  
                                   persistence project. Defaults to Migrations  
        --dry-run                  Print the dotnet ef command without invoking 
                                   it                                           
        --project <PATH>           Path to the Business project. Auto-detected  
                                   from cwd if omitted
